p1.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/ballys-amendment-to-rfa-response-form_september-28-2025.pdf
p1.excerpt: A key component of this commitment is our up to $10 million capital contribution towards the construction of a new NYPD substation for the 45th Precinct.

p2.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/ballys-amendment-to-rfa-response-form_september-28-2025.pdf
p2.excerpt: This was outlined in our Community Benefits Agreement, where we initially intended to fund up to $3 million dollars annually for purposes of staffing. Hearing the request from the CAC, we will amend our commitment to provide $5 million dollars annually for the purposes of staffing and support.

p3.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/cac-response-memo-baly-response-9.27.2025.pdf
p3.excerpt: Yes, we will host an NYPD substation within the property.

p4.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/cac-response-memo-baly-response-9.27.2025.pdf
p4.excerpt: Bally’s has agreed to dedicate $5 million annually for NYPD overtime or Paid Detail programs.

p5.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/cac-response-memo-baly-response-9.27.2025.pdf
p5.excerpt: Confirming that the $5 million annually is for all NYPD associated needs in conjunction with the NYPD substation we will house.

p6.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/gaming-facility-location-board-final-report-and-findings-march-2026
p6.excerpt: The Board notes that Bally’s agreed to increase this amount from $3 million to $5 million during the Community Advisory Committee process.

p7.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/ballys-amendment-to-rfa-response-form_september-28-2025.pdf
p7.excerpt: Upon awarding of a license we will explore and define the appropriate methodology for providing the financial support for all Community Benefit Fund and associated commitments related to the above commitments.

p8.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/ballys-bronx-application-materials
p8.excerpt: Updated records are being uploaded adjacent to (not replacing) existing redacted records on each project’s Application Materials page as they become available.

p9.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/ballys-bronx-application-materials
p9.excerpt: As of May 5, 2026, the following Bally's records denoted with “REVISED REDACTIONS” suffixes have undergone the statutory review process, are considered final, and are posted below.
